profile.headline: MTS @ Koah Labs |  UCSD CS Alum | Formerly @ Roblox, Apple
profile.summary:
I'm a Member of Technical Staff at Koah Labs (https://koahlabs.com/), focusing on building software for an AI-native ad network.

I studied Computer Science at UCSD. During college, I interned at Apple and Roblox.

At UCSD, I was the president of Triton Software Engineering (TSE), a student organization at UCSD that develops software projects pro bono for nonprofit organizations.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Software engineering & data analysis
- Leading our conversion/attribution system development
- Work on mobile SDKs, web app, database, and ETL pipelines

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Full-stack software development & data analysis

positions.title: President
positions.description:
- Triton Software Engineering is a student organization at UCSD that builds software applications pro-bono for nonprofit organizations in our community
- Led 80+ students across 6 project teams, driving event logistics and recruitment
- Supported 5 VPs to manage engineering, design, and product duties within organization

positions.title: VP Technology
positions.description:
-  Advise technical direction of 6 project teams
- Support developers by hosting office hours to answer questions and troubleshoot blockers
- Create technical interview questions and train interviewers 
- Maintain internal tooling for recruitment

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description:
- Led a team of 7 software developers to build an inventory processing web application for Patriots and Paws, a nonprofit organization serving veterans across California, using React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and Firebase
- Assigned tasks, ran weekly team meetings, resolved developer's blockers, and review code to ensure high quality
- Met bi-weekly with product manager, designers, and client representatives to plan features, provide development updates, and seek feedback

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated in 8-developer team to create landing page for FixNation, a nonprofit cat spay & neuter clinic
- Developed navbar, cat biography cards, and involvement opportunities display, using Svelte & TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- My team worked on Roblox Operating System (ROS), an web app with a collection internal tools for employees (e.g. employee directory,, org charts, 3rd party apps integrations)
- Built MCP server for ROS to enable AI integration with ROS API, including OAuth proxy server to support identity-based authentication
- Updated ROS’s performance review chatbot to use Server-Side Events instead of HTTP request/response, drastically reducing request latency
- Built Airflow ETL pipeline to gather ROS usage metrics, including breakdowns by visitor team, employee type, and tool, supporting informed product decisions
- Migrated brittle cron job syncer script to Airflow pipeline, improving maintainability and decreasing load on ROS API

company.name: Competititve Programming Club at UC San Diego

positions.title: Technology Director
positions.description:
- The Competitive Programming Club at UC San Diego participates in the annual International Collegiate Programming Contest (ICPC), a global programming competition focusing on algorithmic problems
- Keep club website (https://icpc.ucsd.edu) up to date
- Help advertise club to recruit more students
- Earned 2nd place at the 2024 Southern California Regional and advanced to 2025 North America Championship, earning 21st place
- ICPC ID: https://icpc.global/ICPCID/TFBTEOG998PP

positions.title: Member
positions.description:
- Competed in the 2024 ICPC Southern California Regional competition
- Attended weekly practices to learn new programming topics and participate in practice contests

positions.title: Web & Mobile Application Programmer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Enhanced iOS app used to diagnose Fetal Alcohol Syndrome (FAS), using SwiftUI and ARKit
- Refined app by enabling comparison of patients’ facial features with expert-defined cutoffs across diverse demographics; developed survey to collect cutoff data from 2 FAS experts, using React, Express, Postgres, and AWS EC2
- Integrated new facial scanning experience and algorithm into app, increasing scan resolution and measurement accuracy
- Added patient facial model & texture export to AWS S3, enabling asynchronous validation of facial measurements
positions.insights: Skills: iOS Development · PostgreSQL · ARKit · Swift (Programming Language) · Express.js · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · SwiftUI

company.name: Qualcomm Institute - UC San Diego Division of Calit2

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on the Game Services UI team
- Developed 2 new features for Apple Game Center to increase engagement and convenience, using Swift and SwiftUI
- Collaborated with design, product, and engineering teams to add new functionality necessary for my projects
- Migrated an application to a new repository, enabling easier integration with new code

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Built TCP & UDP interfaces supporting 25+ messages for embedded laser control system (C++, FreeRTOS, lwIP)
- Completed development of a Python/PyQt GUI to control & monitor system through TCP & UDP interfaces
- Engineered H.265 video streaming feature for embedded computer vision system, using C++ and GStreamer
- Diagnosed & fixed streaming performance bottlenecks, reducing end-to-end latency by 65% and CPU usage by 25%
- Designed & built Android app client to demo streaming for customers, using GStreamer, JNI, and Wi-Fi Direct
- Augmented stream with KLV-encoded metadata (e.g. timestamp, detected objects), displaying received data in app
positions.insights: Skills: Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) · H.264 · lwIP · C++ · PyQt · User Datagram Protocol (UDP) · Python (Programming Language) · Gstreamer · FreeRTOS

positions.title: Embedded Programmer
positions.locationName: San Diego, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Programmed and tested 3 robots for RoboMaster paintball-like competition, using C++ and Mbed OS
- Wrote, tested, and tuned Chassis control system to drive robot using remote input and IMU data

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Collaborated with another engineer to develop the front end of SkillMapper’s website, a search engine for online educational content, using Next.js, React, Redux, MaterialUI, and TypeScript
- Resolved over 150 total issues, including a redesigned landing page, multiple upsells, and a new account settings page
- Grew SkillMapper’s Chrome Extension to 1000+ users by implementing landing page, new UI design, webpage content highlighting feature, and YouTube transcript viewer & highlighter, using React & TypeScript
- Created landing page and front end for new B2B learning & development service, focusing on admin dashboard, employee management, and spending analytics pages
- Prototyped React Native iOS and Android app for SkillMapper; developed home, profile, and saved content screens, and feature to save content to SkillMapper from other apps
positions.insights: Skills: MaterialUI · iOS Development · Next.js · Redux.js · React Native · Android Development · React.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Director
positions.description:
- Programmed robots in Java to compete in a different game every year
- Collaborated with seven other Directors to lead 80-student World Championship-competing team
- Led software subteam to win Autonomous Award, achieve highest average autonomous score, and rank #4 of 40+ teams at Los Angeles Regional by managing and assigning software projects

positions.title: Autonomous Code Development Lead
positions.description: - Tested autonomous navigation code for 2021 competition challenges on team’s robot at my house

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Programmed Arduinos to connect to Wi-Fi and indicate RSSI using LEDs;  researched and designed monopole, dipole, and helical antennas, working with three Boeing mentors and three other interns
- Presented my group’s work to Boeing executives at conclusion of internship
- Attended daily informational talks to learn about different fields and work within Boeing
- Wrote three articles for internship newsletter about satellites, cybersecurity, and my project experiences

projects.title: Algorithm Visualizations
projects.description:
- Built interactive website to animate 5+ algorithms with customizable speed and input size
- Leveraged D3 to render colorful SVG elements representing data structures (arrays and linked lists)

projects.title: Financial Aide
projects.description:
- Created budgeting website where users can track income and expenses and visualize data through charts
- Developed Django Rest API with 20+ endpoints, SwaggerUI documentation, and 50+ unit tests
